steps.u: Review this PR that adds image uploads. Security and robustness. Don't edit.

steps.r:
+ app.post('/upload', upload.single('file'), (req, res) => {
+   const dest = path.join(UPLOAD_DIR, req.file.originalname)
+   fs.renameSync(req.file.path, dest)
+   res.json({ url: '/files/' + req.file.originalname })
+ })

steps.a: Findings. Blocking: the destination uses the client-supplied file name, so a name like ../../x can write outside the upload folder (path traversal), and two users uploading the same name overwrite each other. Blocking: no size limit and no type check, so anyone can fill the disk or upload scripts. Should fix: renameSync blocks the event loop. A generated random name stored alongside the original would fix the first two. I have not edited anything.

reference.summary: Reviewed an image upload PR without editing: the destination path uses the client-supplied file name, allowing path traversal and overwrites, and there is no size limit or type check. It also noted a blocking synchronous rename, and suggested generated names.
